Vendored third-party browser builds — checked in because `public/` has no
build step (plain `<script>` tags, no bundler), so there's nowhere for
`npm install`-managed packages to be loaded from at runtime.

- `marked.umd.js` — from `marked` (see `package.json`'s devDependencies for
  the pinned version). Attaches `window.marked`. To update: `npm install`,
  then `cp node_modules/marked/lib/marked.umd.js public/vendor/marked.umd.js`
  and strip the trailing `//# sourceMappingURL=...` comment (no `.map` file
  is vendored alongside it).

- `mermaid.min.js` — from `mermaid` (see `package.json`'s devDependencies
  for the pinned version). Attaches `globalThis.mermaid`. To update:
  `npm install`, then
  `cp node_modules/mermaid/dist/mermaid.min.js public/vendor/mermaid.min.js`
  (no sourcemap comment to strip — this build doesn't emit one). Large
  (~3.5MB) because it bundles its own layout engine and every diagram
  type's parser; unavoidable at the "one self-contained file, no CDN"
  bar this directory holds everything else to. Fine for a local-only
  tool served from localhost — the cost is a one-time load, not
  per-request bandwidth.

- `svg-pan-zoom.min.js` — from `svg-pan-zoom` (see `package.json`'s
  devDependencies for the pinned version). Attaches `window.svgPanZoom`.
  To update: `npm install`, then
  `cp node_modules/svg-pan-zoom/dist/svg-pan-zoom.min.js public/vendor/svg-pan-zoom.min.js`
  (no sourcemap comment to strip). Gives the Visualizer tab's rendered
  Mermaid diagrams mouse-wheel zoom, drag-to-pan, and on-diagram
  zoom/reset controls — plain CSS `max-width` alone left large diagrams
  too small to read.
